dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags, conflicts, table-only validation, and a repeated-field help example are implemented; no-field flow remains unchanged.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go flag definitions and validateListOpts

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Resolvers use case-insensitive matching, canonical selected fields, sorted candidates for unknown fields/IDs, and sorted ambiguous IDs.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Item fetching already includes the first field page; extra field pages are fetched only when a selection exists and page info requires it, with errors returned before rendering.

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All specified scalar, structured, and multi-value variants render human-readable cells; unknown/missing values are empty and CR/LF normalization is applied.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected headers are appended in request order, values are keyed by field node ID, and absent values produce empty cells without shifting later columns.

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Validation and resolution occur before exporter/table output; lookup and pagination failures are propagated. The focused changes reuse existing query and command helpers.
